about.description: DGLD is a digital proof of ownership of allocated physical gold vaulted in Switzerland, issued by Gold Token SA, the tokenization arm of MKS PAMP. Each token represents 1 fine troy ounce of LBMA Good Delivery PAMP gold held at Castel San Pietro. Backing verified 2026-09-21 against the 2026-08-31 GTSA custodian inventory list, which reconciles bar-for-bar to circulating supply: Ethereum 1,603.687 oz = 4 Swiss bars (PAMP C030727, C031037, C035696, C035700); Base 401.159 oz = bar C075714; Solana 407.109 oz = bar C076016; total 2,411.955 fine oz with zero delta on every leg. Each chain holds its own independently allocated bars with no bridge dependency. NOTE: a Feb 2026 exploit of a non-standard transferFrom in inherited 2022 Consensys code let the Ethereum-Base bridge mint unbacked tokens on Base; contained in ~2.5h, physical gold never at risk, two independent audits followed, the bridge path was closed 2026-06-30 and the old Base contract (0xd02f50E1017F493ffFFa70c8fCf09e349e11d6c9) was deprecated and reset to zero supply.
